title: 胡服騎射 Hufu riding and shooting
description:
Примечания к обновлениюThe first update will be done in a few month.
“Heavy Catapults”...

Об игреBuild market to trade.
Buy perfect dress to riding and shooting.
Great behavior.("Hufu riding and shooting")

建立市场去交易。
购买适合的衣服去骑马与射箭。

伟大的行为。("胡服騎射")

MainMap Control
 Left Mouse click ----goto MainMap Position 
 Right Mouse click ---view MainMap Position
 Mouse Scroll ----Camera near Player or Camera far Player
 “z”“x”---Rotate around view Player

FightMap Control
 "w" "s" "a" "d" "Mouse move"----Control Player Move
 (Like ThirdPersonController)

 "1" "2"----change weapon（1=“Sword”;2=“Bow”;）

 When use sword attack,
 "Left Mouse click"-----Can Attack Enemy.

 When use bow attack,
 You can
 "Left Mouse Press"-----Bow Attack Hold.
 "Left Mouse Up"----Shoot Attack.

大地图键盘鼠标操作：
 鼠标左键点击大地图任意位置----Player将移动到鼠标点击的位置
 鼠标右键点击大地图任意位置----屏幕将跟随鼠标的移动位置（即鼠标移动去哪里，屏幕大地图也去哪里）
 鼠标中间滚轮滑动----摄像机-远离-或者-靠近-大地图
 “z”“x”---旋转视角

战场地图键盘鼠标操作：
 "w" "s" "a" "d" "Mouse move"-----控制玩家移动

 "1" "2"----切换武器

 当使用长剑时，
 “鼠标左键点击”----使用当前武器进行攻击

 当使用弓箭时，
 “鼠标左键点击”----使用当前武器进行攻击
 “鼠标左键按住不松手”----弓箭拉弓瞄准
 “鼠标左键松手”---弓箭发射
description_short: 《胡服騎射 Hufu riding and shooting》is a third-person control RPG Game.From far east mainland, Their are 7 lord in "Zhou" period.This is about 2,200 years ago. you lead your army to ride horses and shoot arrows to expand your land.
